prompt:
Screen-accurate interface design of a desktop web application. NOT a poster, NOT a photograph, NOT a device mockup, NOT a browser window. A flat, straight-on UI screenshot filling the whole canvas. Light theme. English text, left-to-right. It must look like the same product as the attached reference screenshot (the AKR-TMS command centre): same navigation rail, top bar, colours, card style and typography.

Product: AKR-TMS, an anti-money-laundering and KYC monitoring system for Iraqi banks. All names and figures are fictional demo data.

NAVIGATION RAIL (identical to the reference): a left rail about 125 px wide, solid #0F2147, full height. At the very top, a 52 px rounded square in a slightly lighter navy #1A2E5C, left completely EMPTY (the logo is added later: draw nothing inside it). Below it, nine rows, each a thin pale grey-blue line icon with its label to the right in 12 px: Command centre, Alerts, Cases, Customers, Screening, Scenarios, Reports, Data, Governance. The active row has a slightly lighter background and a 3 px gold #C8A24B bar on its left edge.

TOP BAR, about 64 px tall, on the clay background: the page title on the left in 26 px bold #18202F, a muted context line beside it in 15 px #5B6474; on the right a search field with placeholder "Search customers, accounts, cases", a bell icon, and a circular #1E4FA0 avatar with white initials and a role label beside it.

MAIN AREA background #F5F0E6 (warm clay off-white). Cards: white #FFFFFF, 1 px border #DDD6C9, 8 px corner radius, no shadow, 16-20 px padding, about 16 px gaps between cards.
Screen: "Data connection", the health of AKR-TMS's read-only link to the bank's core banking database. Active rail row: Data.

TOP BAR: title "Data connection"; context line "Core banking replica · read-only · data as of 06 Oct 2026, 14:32"; avatar initials "SR", role label "Data steward".

ROW 1: four equal KPI cards, each with a small uppercase label, a large value (40 px bold) and a caption:
- CONNECTION: "Read-only"; caption "Read permission only · checked 14:00" with a green #2F7D4F check icon.
- REPLICA DELAY: "42 s"; caption "Target: under 5 minutes".
- RECONCILIATION: "14 / 14"; caption "Tables match on counts and totals · 03:00 today".
- DATA QUALITY ISSUES: "23"; caption "4 affect monitoring" in amber #B26A00.

ROW 2, two cards:
- Left card, about 60 percent width, "Daily reconciliation · core banking vs AKR-TMS": a table with columns TABLE, CORE BANKING, AKR-TMS, CHECK, STATUS. Rows exactly:
   "Customers | 486,200 | 486,200 | Count | Match"
   "Accounts | 731,452 | 731,452 | Count | Match"
   "Transactions, 05 Oct | 214,380 | 214,380 | Count | Match"
   "Transaction value, 05 Oct (IQD) | 86,412,500,000 | 86,412,500,000 | Sum | Match"
   "Incoming wires, 05 Oct | 1,904 | 1,904 | Count | Match"
   "Card transactions, 05 Oct | 41,220 | 41,220 | Count | Match"
   "Letters of credit, open | 1,118 | 1,118 | Count | Match"
   Each STATUS cell is a small green pill with a tick and the word "Match". Numbers right-aligned with tabular figures.
- Right card, about 40 percent width, "Data quality issues": five rows, each with a coloured severity dot, a bold short title and a grey detail line:
   red dot: "Transfer purpose missing" / "312 outgoing wires · affects wire transfer rules"
   red dot: "Beneficial owner not recorded" / "41 companies · affects customer risk rating"
   amber dot: "Occupation missing" / "1,904 individuals"
   amber dot: "National ID format invalid" / "77 customers"
   grey dot: "One phone number on many customers" / "12 numbers shared by more than 10 customers"
   At the bottom a #1E4FA0 link "View all 23".

ROW 3, full width, card "Feed volume, last 24 hours": a simple line chart in #1F8A8A of rows received per minute, x-axis from "14:30" yesterday to "14:30" today, low at night, peaking around 10:00, y-axis labelled "rows per minute" from 0 to 6,000. At the right end of this card a small boxed figure: "Field mapping: 212 of 215 required fields (98.6%)".
TYPOGRAPHY: a clean humanist sans-serif like IBM Plex Sans throughout; tabular figures for numbers; identifiers such as case numbers in a monospace face; card titles 16 px semibold #18202F; small labels 11-12 px uppercase with slight letter spacing in #5B6474; body text 13-14 px #18202F. All text crisp, legible and correctly spelled English, exactly as written in this description. Do not add any extra text that is not in this description.

COLOURS: use only #0F2147, #1A2E5C, #1E4FA0, #1F8A8A, #C8A24B (active rail marker only), #F5F0E6, #FFFFFF, #18202F, #5B6474, #DDD6C9, #B3261E, #B26A00, #F2A33A, #2F7D4F, plus very light tints of these for chips and pills.

MUST NOT APPEAR: Arabic letters or any non-Latin script, gradients, glows, drop shadows, glassmorphism, 3D effects, perspective tilt, photos, people, emojis, decorative illustrations, lorem ipsum, browser chrome, laptop or monitor frames, watermarks.
